name: CeSpGRN
method_summary: CeSpGRN infers cell-specific gene regulatory networks from scRNA-seq, paired scRNA-seq and scATAC-seq, or spatial transcriptomic data using a kernel-weighted Gaussian Copula Graphical Model. The selected expression and spatial-coordinate paths construct a cell-cell Gaussian kernel, estimate cell-specific precision matrices with ADMM, and transform them to signed partial-correlation networks.

conditional_required.message: groups is required when execution.mode=group_aggregated because ANDREA aggregates CeSpGRN cell-native network rows by group.
conditional_required.usage: ANDREA uses groups.tsv after the native CeSpGRN per-cell run to aggregate cell:<cell_id> rows into group:<group_id> rows; CeSpGRN itself does not consume groups.tsv.

conditional_required.message: spatial_coordinates is required when kernel_source=spatial because CeSpGRN builds the Gaussian kernel from cell locations instead of expression PCA coordinates.
conditional_required.usage: The wrapper should pass the numeric spatial coordinate matrix to kernel.calc_kernel_neigh() when kernel_source=spatial, preserving expression cell identifiers by row alignment.

conditional_required.message: tf_list is required when prior_mode=tf_list because CeSpGRN builds a TF-target mask from known transcription factors.
conditional_required.usage: The wrapper should convert tf_list.txt to CeSpGRN TF gene indices, pass them to G_admm_minibatch(), and use prior_beta to penalize target-target entries outside the TF prior.

progress.note: CeSpGRN trains minibatches with an ADMM loop and prints batch and n_iter diagnostics; the wrapper reports coarse runtime phases in progress.json and records upstream ADMM diagnostics in cespgrn.log.

kernel_source.description: Source used to construct CeSpGRN's cell-cell Gaussian kernel. expression uses PCA coordinates from the expression matrix; spatial uses spatial_coordinates.tsv.

prior_mode.description: Optional prior-mask mode. none runs the expression/spatial CeSpGRN path without a prior; tf_list uses known TFs to construct the TF-target mask described by the paper.

expression_preprocessing.description: Preprocessing applied before PCA, covariance estimation and ADMM. library_size_log1p mirrors upstream examples by scaling each cell to the median library size and applying log1p; none passes the mounted expression values through unchanged.

pca_components.description: Number of PCA components used when kernel_source=expression. Upstream examples use 10 or 20 components; the wrapper should require this to be no larger than the available cells and genes.

bandwidth.description: Gaussian kernel bandwidth. Smaller values allow cell GRNs to vary more quickly; larger values smooth GRNs across more neighboring cells.

n_neigh.description: Number of neighbors retained in the truncated kernel used for cell-specific covariance estimation.

lamb.description: L1 sparsity regularization weight passed to G_admm_minibatch.train(); larger values produce sparser networks.

prior_beta.description: Prior regularization weight used only when prior_mode=tf_list. The wrapper should pass beta=0 when prior_mode=none and prior_beta when prior_mode=tf_list.

max_iters.description: Maximum ADMM iterations per minibatch passed to G_admm_minibatch.train(). The upstream demo uses 1000; benchmark scripts often use smaller values.

n_intervals.description: Iteration interval for ADMM diagnostics and convergence checks.

batch_size.description: Minibatch size for G_admm_minibatch. Null preserves the upstream constructor default int(ncells/10); an integer passes an explicit batchsize.

oneOf.description: Explicit number of cells per ADMM minibatch.
Use null to omit batchsize and preserve CeSpGRN's data-dependent int(ncells/10) constructor rule.

random_seed.description: Torch random seed passed to G_admm_minibatch. Use null to omit seeding.

oneOf.description: Use null to pass seed=None and preserve unseeded torch runtime behavior.

artifacts_aux.description: Combined stdout/stderr log from preprocessing, kernel construction, covariance estimation and ADMM training.
